SECTION: === SECTION 4: HONEST CAVEATS — READ BEFORE YOU RELY ON THIS DATA ===

ITEM: Most factories in the system are NOT in this list
DETAIL 1: The database actually holds 1,946 factories total. 1,644 of those were bulk-imported from an old legacy export we have flagged as messy (missing names, wrong products for the sector, placeholder text, duplicate patterns) and were never cleaned up before import. Another ~400 are throwaway test/demo clutter created by automated test runs. The 24 factories in Section 2 are the only ones we're confident are clean and safe to build a demo or test plan around.

ITEM: Two factories carry almost all the bulk visit volume
DETAIL 1: Al Watania Plastics (102 visits) and Sudair Polymer Co. (267 visits) are not curated stories — they're where repeated automated test runs piled up over time. Use them for testing search/filter/pagination at scale, not for a clean walkthrough.

Even for the 24 clean factories, only 4 (F-2214, F-2215, F-2216, F-3303) have a real product/raw-material profile filled in. None of the 24 have a legal name, licence status, or CR status recorded. Don't expect Factory 360 to look fully populated except on those 4.

ITEM: Only one inspector account has real work assigned
DETAIL 1: All 345 seeded visits/inspections against the 24 clean factories are assigned to a single inspector account (inspector@mim.gov.sa). There is no second inspector to test hand-off/reassignment between two real people today.

ITEM: No samples/seizure or factory-discrepancy scenarios exist
DETAIL 1: These two workflow types have no database table yet, so nothing can be seeded for them at all — not a data gap, a feature not yet built.

ITEM: Trusted-device / biometric field login is visual only
DETAIL 1: The new mobile field sign-in screen shows no fake 'trusted device' or fingerprint option, because there is no real feature behind it yet — that would have meant showing you something that doesn't work.
